Effect: [On Play] [When Digivolving] By trashing 1 card in your hand, until your opponent's turn ends, 1 of your Digimon with the [Demon], [Shaman] or [Titan] trait gains ＜Blocker＞ and ＜Retaliation＞.
[On Deletion] You may play 1 level 4 or lower [Demon] or [Titan] trait Digimon card from your trash without paying the cost.
Inherited Effect: [Your Turn] While this Digimon is [Titamon] or has the [Titan] trait, it gains ＜Security A. +1＞.
